name: bioluma-mobile
description: Bioluma native shells for Android and iOS (Capacitor). Loads the built web game from ../../dist; works offline, no domain needed.

scripts.add:android: cap add android && npm run assets -- --android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android
scripts.add:ios: cap add ios && npm run assets -- --ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.sync:android: cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android
scripts.sync:ios: cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
